analysis-report-cost.name: Descriptive Statistics Report Calculator
analysis-report-cost.intro: Paste a series of numbers and derive the count, sum, mean, median, minimum, maximum, range, variance and standard deviation in one report block.

antipyretic-dose.name: Pediatric Antipyretic Liquid Dose Calculator
antipyretic-dose.intro: Compute the single antipyretic dose in millilitres from a child's weight and the suspension concentration, with minimum and maximum dosing interval warnings included.

apgar.name: Apgar Score Calculator
apgar.intro: Score appearance, pulse, grimace, activity and respiration at one and five minutes after birth, and read the summed result with its clinical interpretation band.

bac-calculator.name: Blood Alcohol Content Calculator
bac-calculator.intro: Estimate blood alcohol concentration from the number of standard drinks, body weight, sex and elapsed hours, applying the Widmark factor and hourly elimination rate.

blood-pressure-grade.name: Blood Pressure Grade Classifier
blood-pressure-grade.intro: Classify a systolic and diastolic reading into the normal, elevated or hypertension grade bands, and show pulse pressure and mean arterial pressure for context.

bmi-2.name: BMI Percentile Estimator for Children
bmi-2.intro: Estimate the BMI percentile for a child or adolescent from age, sex, height and weight, and map the result to the underweight, healthy, overweight or obesity band.

bmi-calculator.name: Body Mass Index Calculator
bmi-calculator.intro: Compute BMI from height and weight in metric or imperial units, then place the value in the standard adult bands with the healthy weight range shown alongside.

bmr-calculator.name: Basal Metabolic Rate Calculator
bmr-calculator.intro: Estimate resting daily calorie burn with the Mifflin-St Jeor equation from height, weight, age and sex, as the baseline for any nutrition or weight plan.

body-fat-estimator.name: Body Fat Percentage Estimator
body-fat-estimator.intro: Estimate body fat percentage from waist, neck, hip and height using the US Navy circumference method, with the sex-specific formula and fitness band shown.

bsa-calculator.name: Body Surface Area Calculator
bsa-calculator.intro: Estimate body surface area with the DuBois equation from height and weight, used to size chemotherapy doses, burn fluid plans and paediatric drug dosing.

chads-vasc.name: CHADS2-VASc Stroke Risk Score
chads-vasc.intro: Total the congestive heart failure, hypertension, age, diabetes, stroke, vascular disease and sex items to obtain the annual stroke risk and anticoagulation hint.

checker-manager.name: Management System Compliance Self-Check
checker-manager.intro: Score eight management system check items together with the recorded temperature and humidity, then read the total out of 80 as a percentage readiness grade.

due-date-calc.name: Pregnancy Week and Due Date Calculator
due-date-calc.intro: Enter the last menstrual period or a known conception date to derive gestational age, the estimated due date and the current trimester with a week-by-week table.

egfr.name: Estimated Glomerular Filtration Rate Calculator
egfr.intro: Estimate eGFR from serum creatinine, age and sex using the CKD-EPI equation, and stage the result from G1 to G5 with the chronic kidney disease category.

egfr-calculator.name: eGFR Calculator with CKD-EPI and MDRD
egfr-calculator.intro: Compare the CKD-EPI and MDRD study estimates of glomerular filtration rate side by side from creatinine, age and sex, and read the matching kidney function stage.

fat-loss-deficit.name: Fat Loss Calorie Deficit Planner
fat-loss-deficit.intro: Set a daily calorie deficit from your maintenance level and target weekly weight loss, then see the projected timeline and the safe lower bound for intake.

gfr-cockcroft.name: Cockcroft-Gault Creatinine Clearance Calculator
gfr-cockcroft.intro: Estimate creatinine clearance with the Cockcroft-Gault equation from age, weight, sex and serum creatinine, the estimate still used for many renal drug dose adjustments.

healthcare.name: Paediatric Dose Conversion Calculator
healthcare.intro: Convert an adult dose to a child dose by weight or by body surface area, with Clark's rule, Young's rule and the BSA method compared side by side.

healthcare-2.name: IV Drip Rate Calculator
healthcare-2.intro: Convert a prescribed infusion volume and duration into drops per minute and millilitres per hour for a given drop factor, with a rounded practical setting suggested.

healthcare-3.name: Hyponatraemia Correction Rate Calculator
healthcare-3.intro: Work out the safe sodium correction rate and the infusion rate needed to raise serum sodium without exceeding the daily limit that risks osmotic demyelination.

healthcare-4.name: NYHA Heart Function Classifier
healthcare-4.intro: Grade cardiac function from I to IV by the degree of activity limitation and symptom pattern, following the New York Heart Association functional classification.

healthcare-5.name: Daily Protein Requirement Calculator
healthcare-5.intro: Derive the daily protein target in grams from body weight and activity goal, from sedentary maintenance through endurance training to resistance training and cutting.

heart-rate-zones.name: Heart Rate Training Zone Calculator
heart-rate-zones.intro: Derive the five training zones from resting and maximum heart rate using the Karvonen method, and see the warm-up, aerobic, threshold and VO2 max bands.

ibw.name: Ideal Body Weight Calculator
ibw.intro: Estimate ideal body weight from height and sex with the Devine and Robinson formulas, and display the healthy weight range and adjusted body weight for dosing.

ideal-weight.name: Devine Ideal Weight Estimator
ideal-weight.intro: Compute ideal body weight with the Devine formula plus the Hamwi, Miller and Robinson variants, and compare your current weight against each estimate.

map.name: Mean Arterial Pressure Calculator
map.intro: Compute mean arterial pressure as diastolic plus one third of the pulse pressure, the value used to judge organ perfusion in shock and critical care monitoring.

morse.name: Morse Fall Risk Assessment
morse.intro: Score the six Morse fall scale items including fall history, secondary diagnosis, ambulatory aid, IV therapy, gait and mental status, and read the risk level.

nrs2002.name: NRS 2002 Nutritional Risk Screening
nrs2002.intro: Screen nutritional risk with the NRS 2002 tool by combining the impaired nutritional status score, disease severity score and the age adjustment.

parkland.name: Parkland Burn Fluid Resuscitation Calculator
parkland.intro: Compute the Parkland formula fluid volume for the first 24 hours from body weight and burn percentage, and split it into the first 8 hours and the remaining 16.

qtc.name: Corrected QT Interval Calculator
qtc.intro: Correct the QT interval for heart rate with the Bazett, Fridericia, Framingham and Hodges formulas, and flag the prolongation thresholds for each method.

resp-rate.name: Respiratory Rate Assessor
resp-rate.intro: Enter an observed breathing rate with the patient's age band to judge whether it is normal, bradypnoeic or tachypnoeic, with the reference ranges shown per age.

tdee-calculator.name: Total Daily Energy Expenditure Calculator
tdee-calculator.intro: Multiply your basal metabolic rate by an activity factor to get total daily energy expenditure, then show the cut, maintain and bulk calorie targets derived from it.

water-intake.name: Daily Water Intake Recommender
water-intake.intro: Estimate daily fluid needs from body weight, activity duration and climate, and break the total between plain water, beverages and the water held in food.

weight-dosage.name: Weight Based Drug Dosage Calculator
weight-dosage.intro: Convert a milligram per kilogram prescription into a total single dose and a daily total from body weight and dosing frequency, with the maximum limit checked.

wells.name: Wells Pulmonary Embolism Score
wells.intro: Total the Wells criteria items for suspected pulmonary embolism and read the two-tier or three-tier probability band together with the suggested next diagnostic step.
